how: surface samples at <= 1.0 mm spacing rasterised into a shared 2.0 mm voxel grid; adjacent = a voxel of one touches a voxel of the other in the 3x3x3 neighbourhood, i.e. surface-to-surface separation <= 3.46 mm (and <= 2.0 mm for a face-touching pair). Measured on this page's own shipped meshes by scripts/anatomy/q298/adjacency_q298.py. A measurement, not an anatomical claim.
